Hi Sam / Lisa,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited to move to a short technical deep dive so our SE can walk through architecture, latency/cost tradeoffs, and on-prem/VPC options. Objectives for the session:
- Live demo of a sample payment routing prompt + observability walkthrough
- Discuss KV/prefix caching and quantization options for cost reduction
- Security & data flow Q&A with your cloud/security team

Proposed 60–75 minute slots (all in PT):
- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:15
- Tue Apr 20, 14:00–15:15
- Wed Apr 21, 09:00–10:15

Dylan (SE) is cc'd — can you confirm availability and who from your engineering/security/procurement team should join? If procurement wants to be involved we can keep the first 10 minutes for contracting checklist items.

Attached: demo-slide-deck.pptx (high-level). Will follow up with a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks,
Alex

alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Alex — thanks, that looks great. We want the session to focus on:
- Latency patterns for 512–2048 token sequences
- KV cache behavior across short-lived vs long-lived sessions
- How private (VPC) deployments change observability and audit log access

Attendees from our side: Sam Hayes (platform), Rafael Ortega (cloud security) — Rafael is external consultant (cc not added here yet), and Lisa Chen (procurement) will join for the contracting segment if we keep it brief.

Preferred times: the Wed Apr 21 morning slot works best for the engineers. If possible, can you do Wed Apr 21 09:00 PT? If not, Tue Apr 20 14:00 PT is our second choice.

Also — can you call out whether Redwood can provide an on-prem demo or if the VPC option is the closest representation for our compliance needs?

Best,
